title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre - University of California on 1981-09-12
lineage: MAC (dolby B) > Nakamichi CR-5A (Dolby B) >  Tascam HD-P2 > 24/96 Wave > Wavelab 5 > plugins > r8brain pro > 16/44.1 wave > CD wave > flac lvl 8 (TLH)
taper: anonymous taper, Jamie Poris, Mark Severson
source: 3 Nakamichi 700's (l & R-Cross Cardiod, 6db Bass EQ, 75 Deg angle, center-omni straight at stage, 40 deg up)  40 feet from stage, dead center > 3 mic mixer(made by Jamie Poris) > Sony D5 > MAC (dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Stellar audience recording captures a high‑energy early‑80s performance with standout versions of Shakedown Street, The Greatest Story Ever Told and Friend of the Devil.
ai_review.review: The show radiates the sparkling energy of a hometown gig, delivering crisp jams and memorable renditions of Shakedown Street, The Greatest Story Ever Told and Friend of the Devil. The front‑of‑house audience tape is clean and full despite minor high‑end unevenness from Dolby B processing, making it an enjoyable listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: All eight reviews are highly positive (mostly 5 stars) praising both the musical performance and the audience recording; minor tonal quirks keep the rating just shy of perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑house tape is clean and full. Dolby B reduction causes a slightly uneven high end and a lean low end, but overall the mix is clear and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers note a 'greatest‑hits' style setlist that flows smoothly, delivering high energy and purposeful Garcia leads throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's playing is highlighted as vibrant, purposeful, and reminiscent of his earlier work.
